guidance.nninteractive_v1_prompted: nnInteractive: place a positive point inside one node; use negatives to exclude adjacent vessels. One structure per prompt; repeat for other nodes.
guidance.segvol_prompted_ct: SegVol: use points or a tight 3D box around one node. Do not combine points and a box. No verified nodal text vocabulary.
guidance.voxtell_v1_1_text_prompted: VoxTell: one text target per job. Points and boxes are ignored. Cached terms do not prove elective-region accuracy.
guidance.medical_sam3_3d_prompted: Medical-SAM3: text and one box; eight adjacent axial slices only, with zero output outside the window. Points are ignored. Exact nodal training wording is unverified.
guidance.pam_prompted: PAM: one seed slice. Positive points become disks and a box becomes a filled rectangle; negative points are ignored. Mask/scribble input and the published Box2Mask workflow are not implemented.
guidance.sat3d_prompted: SAT3D: points select one local object within a 128³ native-voxel crop; output outside the crop is zero.
guidance.vista3d_prompted_ct: VISTA3D: at least one positive CT point; negatives can exclude adjacent tissue. No text contract.
guidance.sam_med3d_turbo_prompted: SAM-Med3D Turbo: points select one local object; a box becomes its centre point. The crop is 128³ at 1.5 mm.
guidance.medsam2_ct_lesion_prompted: MedSAM2: points or a box on one axial slice. A box overrides points; only the largest 3D component is retained.
guidance.medical_sam2_prompted_ct: Medical-SAM2: points or a box on one axial slice; box overrides points. Only the largest 3D component is retained. The checkpoint was trained on organs.
guidance.sam_med2d_prompted: SAM-Med2D: prompt every intended slice; no propagation to other slices.
guidance.medsam_vit_b_box_2d: MedSAM ViT-B: one box on one slice; no volume propagation.
guidance.biomedparse_prompted: BiomedParse: checkpoint access is blocked; no active text suggestions.
